name: rivet
description: Explore and compare design directions for a local web app.

interface.longDescription:
Rivet is a design partner that helps you explore more ideas. Rivet proposes and creates different design directions with you.  Bring in references from Pinterest, Are.na and other sources, then use these to create more creative variants that match your taste.

Explore those directions in Rivet’s interface with live previews you can view and compare side by side. Give feedback, develop the ideas that resonate, and bring your chosen prototype back into your project as working code.
